# Isaiah Chapter 46 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 13 verses]*

*Bel and Nebo fall; idols carried by beasts; God carries Israel; no one like God*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** I have made, and I will bear; I will carry and will save. This chapter bel and nebo fall.

*-- LOGOS*
